fields.name: Frikk Eikeland
fields.bio: Frikk founded Barkpark and leads its core engineering. He spends his days deep in the Phoenix API, the content-graph model, and the Postgres-backed search index that powers the headless CMS. Before Barkpark he built ingest pipelines for publishing systems; now he's obsessed with making structured content fast to query, easy to model, and a joy to wire into any frontend. He writes about schema design, GROQ-style queries, and the trade-offs of building a CMS that stays useful with every plugin turned off.
